name: SumMin_SmallerLeader
description: Players may prefer to select the index i in landmark_positions that minimizes squared_distance(ego_agent_position, landmark_positions[i]) + squared_distance(other_agent_position, landmark_positions[i]). Break ties by smaller squared_distance(min(ego_agent_position, other_agent_position), landmark_positions[i]) using lexicographic order on (x, y), then by the smallest i.
